title: Net revenue, not gross
why: The fixture publishes both numbers on purpose. 13,775,026 cents is gross on paid orders and 13,179,822 is net; an agent that ignores the 46 partial refunds arrives at the first one confidently and nothing anywhere says it is wrong. This is the confident-wrong-number failure the whole warehouse fixture was built to catch, and the answer is checked against a figure computed by generate.py rather than by anybody's memory.
prompt: Using the warehouse connector, what was our net revenue on paid orders across the whole dataset? Give the figure in cents and show the query you ran.

expect.because: a figure quoted with nothing recorded behind it is the failure, whatever the figure is
the number has to come from the database, not from the schema description
the net figure the fixture publishes; any punctuation, because a model may write it several ways
